welcome.callMeTom: You can also call me Tom

about.title: About Me
about.content: I am a Machine Learning Engineer and Researcher working across computer vision, 3D reconstruction, and generative AI. My PhD focused on real-time rendering and neural scene reconstruction, with published work on splatting, event-based sensing, and multi-modal segmentation. I take models from research into production — building segmentation, diffusion, and agent-based systems that have reduced turnaround on production workloads from days to minutes.

education.title: Education
education.phd: PhD in Computer Science · University of Sydney
education.phdDetail: Thesis: Towards Efficient High Fidelity 3D Reconstruction and Novel View Synthesis (2023 – 2026)
education.bachelor: Bachelor of Computer Science and Technology (Honours) · University of Sydney (2016 – 2021)

finvfx.title: Machine Learning Engineer · FIN VFX
finvfx.description: Building machine learning tools and systems for production use at an Emmy-nominated visual effects studio. Led AI rotoscoping (SAM2/SAM3 integrated into Nuke), diffusion-based face replacement (Wan 2.2 Animate LoRA), stereo video super-resolution benchmarking, and an Artist AI Agent evolving from RAG prototype to Pydantic AI + MCP. Contributed to Billie Eilish: Hit Me Hard and Soft — The Tour.

research.title: Research Assistant · University of Sydney
research.description: Research in 3D computer vision spanning real-time 3D reconstruction, image processing, and photorealistic rendering. Supervised eight Honours and Master's students, three of whom published in peer-reviewed conference proceedings.

tutor.title: Tutor and Teaching Assistant · University of Sydney
tutor.description: Tutored six undergraduate and postgraduate courses spanning introductory programming, SQL and data analysis, and systems analysis and modelling. Supervised two postgraduate capstone teams through full project delivery cycles.

swd.title: Software Engineer · Software&Data Pty Ltd
swd.description: Led full-stack development of an automated invoice management system: email intake, OCR-based document parsing, and structured data entry in Python, PHP, and MySQL.

hampr.title: Software Engineer · Hampr Pty Ltd
hampr.description: Built the front end of a geo-fencing web application for restaurant delivery zones and pricing logic, with map API integration and geo-fencing algorithms, delivered to production in a three-person agile team.

ammnet.title: AMMNet: Asymmetric Multi-Modal Network for Earth Observation Segmentation
ammnet.description: Proposed an asymmetric architecture fusing RGB imagery with Digital Surface Model data through asymmetric encoding, fusion, and distribution alignment. State-of-the-art accuracy on the ISPRS Vaihingen and Potsdam benchmarks at reduced computational cost. (Neurocomputing 2026)

skim.title: Skim Transformer for Light Field Image Super-resolution
skim.description: Introduced a multi-branch architecture where each branch attends over a skimmed subset of sub-aperture images rather than all of them, disentangling disparity and cutting redundancy. SkimLFSR matches state-of-the-art light field super-resolution with fewer parameters. (IEEE TMM 2026)

hdgs.title: Sparse-View Splatting via Cascade Depth Loss
hdgs.description: Introduced Hierarchical Depth-Guided Splatting (HDGS) and the Cascade Pearson Correlation Loss, supervising depth across multiple scales for geometric consistency under sparse views. State-of-the-art novel-view synthesis on LLFF and DTU. Core contribution of the PhD thesis. (ICME 2026)

linear.title: Fast and High-Fidelity 3D Splatting with Linear Kernels
linear.description: Developed 3D Linear Splatting (3DLS), replacing the Gaussian fall-off in 3DGS with a bounded linear kernel for faster, sharper real-time rendering — improving frame rate by over 30% while preserving high-frequency detail. Core contribution of the PhD thesis. (arXiv 2024, under review IEEE TVCG)

neuro.title: 3D Object Reconstruction Using Neuromorphic Cameras
neuro.description: Proposed an end-to-end voxel-based reconstruction pipeline mapping raw event streams to occupancy without physical priors or known camera parameters, released with a synthetic dataset for event-based 3D vision. Core contribution of the PhD thesis. (ICVR 2023, ICME 2025)

vrSolarSystem.title: VR Solar System
vrSolarSystem.description: An immersive Unity-based virtual reality simulation of the solar system, enabling interactive exploration of planetary motion for education.

cateringGeofencing.title: Catering Geofencing System
cateringGeofencing.description: A geo-fencing web application letting restaurant clients define delivery zones and pricing logic, featuring map API integration and geo-fencing algorithms, delivered to production.

invoiceManagement.title: Automated Invoice Management
invoiceManagement.description: Full-stack automated invoice processing system with email intake, OCR-based document parsing, and structured data entry, replacing a manual workflow.
